u0: Initial state: the agent has not yet picked up the matching key, so key-holding progress is zero and the locked door remains closed. The current objective is to locate and pick up the key whose color matches the door; doing so advances to u1.
u1: The matching key has been acquired at least once, satisfying the first key-holding milestone, but the two-move key requirement is not yet secured and the door is still closed. Keep or reacquire the key: holding it through another move while the door stays closed advances to u2, while opening the door while still holding it advances directly to u3. If the key has been dropped, recover it before attempting the door.
u2: The agent has held the matching key on at least two separate moves with the door still closed, so the repeated-key requirement is complete; the agent may or may not currently be carrying the key. The next objective is to open the matching door, reacquiring the key first if necessary; once the door is opened, advance to u3.
u3: The matching door has been opened at least once and the key-holding condition is complete, but the mission box has not been picked up. If the key is still in hand, drop it to free the hand; if the door has since closed, reopen it, then enter the second room and pick up the mission-designated box to reach u4.
u4: Terminal success: the agent is carrying the mission-designated box, the objective is complete, and the episode ends. No further subtask is required.
